Method of Attack: Exploiting a vulnerability in Hyper-V's network switch driver (vmswitch.sys) that does not validate the value of an OID request, allowing dereferencing of an invalid pointer
Sending specially crafted packets from a guest VM to the Hyper-V host to cause host crash (denial of service) or remote code execution
Attack Vector: Access to guest virtual machine and sending crafted packets to Hyper-V host
